conclusion: An incremental WebGL build cache reproducibly omits MonoScript native registration in this minimal project. An empty Library fixes the first build, but a subsequent incremental build can reintroduce the omission. CleanBuildCache fixes the exact current production source in two successive builds with zero startup errors. The individual cache file is not identified.
